name: Rivet Cannon
description: A squat brass cannon that hammers red-hot rivets into anything on the road.
flavor: Every foundry's first line of defence, and usually its last.

upgrades.name: Double Barrel
upgrades.description: A second barrel doubles the clatter. +60% fire rate.

upgrades.name: Shrapnel Rivets
upgrades.description: Rivets burst on impact, spraying fragments.

upgrades.name: Armour-Piercing Bolts
upgrades.description: Tungsten-tipped bolts punch through plate and the enemy behind it.

upgrades.name: Dreadnought Battery
upgrades.description: Three barrels fire in unison; every fifth volley is a thunderous broadside.

abilities.name: Triple Barrels
abilities.description: Fires at three targets at once.

abilities.name: Broadside
abilities.description: Every fifth volley deals quadruple damage.

synergies.name: Ranged Spotting
synergies.description: A nearby Spotter walks the rivets onto target: +15% range.

name: Gatling Nest
description: A crank-driven rotary gun on a swivel mount. Tracks both ground and air targets.
flavor: Six barrels, one opinion.

upgrades.name: Spin-Up Motor
upgrades.description: A steam motor periodically spins the barrels to a blur.

abilities.name: Spin-Up
abilities.description: Every 10s, doubles fire rate for 4s.

upgrades.name: Tungsten Cores
upgrades.description: Dense cores pierce plating. +30% damage, ignores 4 armour.

upgrades.name: Brass Hurricane
upgrades.description: A twin-mounted storm of lead that finds weak points.

abilities.name: Twin Mount
abilities.description: Engages two targets simultaneously.

synergies.name: Overpressure
synergies.description: Booster steam drives the crank harder: +10% fire rate.

name: Railgun Turret
description: Magnetic rails fling a steel slug at hypersonic speed in a perfectly straight line.
flavor: It does not miss. It merely has not fired yet.

upgrades.name: Overpenetration
upgrades.description: Slugs pass through four more enemies.

upgrades.name: Weak-Point Scanner
upgrades.description: 30% chance to strike a weak point for triple damage.

upgrades.name: Orbital Rail
upgrades.description: Relays targeting to an orbital mass driver that periodically obliterates the strongest foe.

abilities.name: Orbital Strike
abilities.description: Every 12s, a 3000 damage strike hits the toughest enemy in range.

name: Mortar Tower
description: A stubby siege mortar that lobs explosive shells over walls. Cannot hit targets that are too close.
flavor: What goes up comes down on your enemies.

upgrades.name: Cluster Shells
upgrades.description: Shells split into bomblets. +40% blast radius.

upgrades.name: Incendiary Payload
upgrades.description: Shells leave burning pools on the road.

abilities.name: Burning Crater
abilities.description: Impacts burn for 3s.

upgrades.name: Concussion Charge
upgrades.description: Blast waves have a 30% chance to stun.

upgrades.name: Siege Barrage
upgrades.description: Four tubes fire a creeping barrage.

abilities.name: Barrage
abilities.description: Fires four shells at different targets.

name: Flak Battery
description: Twin anti-air guns that fill the sky with timed bursts. Cannot engage ground targets.
flavor: Airships are just very large targets.

upgrades.name: Proximity Fuses
upgrades.description: Shells burst nearer their target. +50% blast radius.

upgrades.name: Chaff Shells
upgrades.description: Metal chaff fouls rotors: slows air units by 30%.

upgrades.name: Skyfall Curtain
upgrades.description: Periodically fills the whole sky around it with a wall of flak.

abilities.name: Flak Curtain
abilities.description: Every 6s, deals 250 damage to all air units within 5 tiles.

synergies.name: Sky Watch
synergies.description: +20% damage while a Spotter is near.

name: Harpoon Launcher
description: A whaling gun repurposed for machines. Harpoons drag targets back down the road.
flavor: Reel them in. Then reel them in again.

upgrades.name: Barbed Heads
upgrades.description: Barbs tear open plating: targets take +20% damage for 3s.

upgrades.name: Winch Motor
upgrades.description: A steam winch doubles the pull distance.

upgrades.name: Anchor Pin
upgrades.description: Harpoons pin targets in place for 1.2s.

upgrades.name: Leviathan Reel
upgrades.description: A colossal winch periodically hauls every nearby enemy backwards.

abilities.name: Leviathan Reel
abilities.description: Every 8s, drags all enemies within 3 tiles back 3 tiles.

synergies.name: Kill Zone
synergies.description: Harpooned clusters are perfect mortar targets: +15% damage.

name: Tesla Coil
description: A crackling copper coil that arcs lightning between enemies.
flavor: Mr. Tesla sends his regards.

upgrades.name: Longer Chains
upgrades.description: Arcs leap to three more targets and further.

upgrades.name: Overload Mode
upgrades.description: Every fifth discharge overloads for quadruple damage and a brief stun.

abilities.name: Overload
abilities.description: Every 5th bolt deals 4x damage and stuns for 0.5s.

abilities.name: EMP Burst
abilities.description: Every 6s, deals 40 damage and stuns everything within 2.5 tiles for 1s.

abilities.name: Thunder God Protocol
abilities.description: Every 8s, six lightning bolts strike random enemies anywhere on the map.

synergies.name: Grid Coupling
synergies.description: Adjacent electrical towers share load: +1 chain.

name: Arc Tower
description: A pair of carbon electrodes that sustain a continuous arc on one target, growing hotter the longer it holds.
flavor: Hold still. This will only hurt forever.

upgrades.name: Arc Splitter
upgrades.description: The arc forks to a second target at 60% strength.

abilities.name: Forked Arc
abilities.description: Beam splits to 1 extra target at 60% damage.

upgrades.name: Ramping Arc
upgrades.description: Heats up twice as fast, to a higher peak.

upgrades.name: Galvanic Weld
upgrades.description: The arc welds joints stiff: slows the target by 25%.

upgrades.name: Voltaic Lance
upgrades.description: A blinding lance of plasma that splinters across the battlefield.

abilities.name: Voltaic Splinters
abilities.description: Beam splits to 4 extra targets at 70% damage.

name: Storm Generator
description: A copper dome that brews a miniature thunderstorm, zapping everything nearby in pulses.
flavor: Forecast: overcast with a chance of annihilation.

abilities.name: Ball Lightning
abilities.description: Leaves 2s electric fields dealing 30 dps.

upgrades.name: Tempest Engine
upgrades.description: The storm breaks loose across the map.

abilities.name: Tempest
abilities.description: Every 5s, three 300-damage bolts strike random enemies.

synergies.name: Lightning Rod
synergies.description: Tesla coils ground the storm: +20% damage.

name: Galvanic Mine Layer
description: Scatters voltaic mines onto nearby roads that detonate under passing feet.
flavor: Watch your step. Actually, don't bother.

upgrades.name: Shock Mines
upgrades.description: Detonations have a 60% chance to stun for 1s.

upgrades.name: Chain Detonation
upgrades.description: Blasts arc to two nearby enemies.

upgrades.name: Minefield Matrix
upgrades.description: Carpets the road with overlapping charges.

synergies.name: Snared
synergies.description: Slowed enemies linger on mines: +15% damage.

name: Incinerator
description: A pressurised flamethrower that bathes the road in a cone of burning oil.
flavor: Warmth for the whole family.

upgrades.name: Sticky Fuel
upgrades.description: Burns twice as hot and 2s longer.

upgrades.name: Dragon's Breath
upgrades.description: A roaring wall of fire that leaves the road ablaze.

abilities.name: Scorched Earth
abilities.description: Leaves burning ground (40 dps for 3s).

name: Furnace Tower
description: A blast furnace that periodically exhales a ring of searing heat.
flavor: Stoked day and night by a very enthusiastic automaton.

upgrades.name: Heart of the Forge
upgrades.description: Periodically erupts with a devastating firestorm.

abilities.name: Forge Eruption
abilities.description: Every 7s, deals 400 fire damage within 3 tiles.

name: Napalm Projector
description: Lobs canisters of jellied fire that splash and keep burning.
flavor: Sticks to everything. Especially regret.

abilities.name: Napalm Pool
abilities.description: Impacts burn for 4s at 18 dps.

abilities.name: Long Burn
abilities.description: Pools burn for 7s at 18 dps.

abilities.name: Wildfire
abilities.description: Kills explode for 40% of max HP within 1.2 tiles.

abilities.name: Firestorm
abilities.description: Three canisters per volley.

upgrades.name: Inferno Carpet
upgrades.description: Blankets the road in an unending sea of fire.

abilities.name: Inferno
abilities.description: Pools burn for 8s at 60 dps over a wide area.

name: Boiler Bomb
description: Catapults scrap boilers primed to rupture, blasting enemies with steam and shrapnel.
flavor: Health and safety has left the building.

upgrades.name: Pressure Wave
upgrades.description: Blasts hurl enemies a full tile further back.

upgrades.name: Grand Boiler Rupture
upgrades.description: Every third boiler is a locomotive engine.

abilities.name: Locomotive
abilities.description: Every 3rd bomb deals 5x damage in a 3-tile blast.

name: Acid Sprayer
description: Hoses a fine mist of vitriol that eats through armour plating.
flavor: Rust never sleeps. We help it along.

upgrades.name: Concentrated Acid
upgrades.description: Corrodes twice as fast, to 6 more armour.

abilities.name: Caustic Pool
abilities.description: Leaves 3s acid pools at 15 dps.

abilities.name: Dissolve
abilities.description: Instantly destroys non-boss enemies below 12% health.

name: Corrosion Pump
description: Fires pressurised globs of rust accelerant at ground and air targets.
flavor: Oxidation, but make it fast.

upgrades.name: Deep Corrosion
upgrades.description: +1 corrosion per hit, up to 10 more.

upgrades.name: Oxidation Cascade
upgrades.description: Kills burst into clouds of rust.

abilities.name: Rust Cloud
abilities.description: Kills explode for 50% max HP within 1.5 tiles.

name: Toxic Diffuser
description: Vents a pulsing cloud of poison that hits everything around it, even aircraft.
flavor: Do not inhale. Do not exhale either.

upgrades.name: Contagion
upgrades.description: Poisoned enemies spread it on death.

abilities.name: Contagion
abilities.description: Kills burst for 30% max HP within 1.4 tiles.

upgrades.name: Miasma Engine
upgrades.description: Leaves a creeping miasma everywhere it pulses.

abilities.name: Miasma
abilities.description: Pulses leave 6s toxic clouds at 45 dps.

name: Alchemical Still
description: A bubbling alembic that fires volatile elixirs; its reagents can transmute scrap into gold.
flavor: Lead into gold. Automatons into lead.

upgrades.name: Philosopher's Drip
upgrades.description: Kills by this tower yield +25% gold.

abilities.name: Transmute
abilities.description: Destroys non-boss enemies below 8% health.

abilities.name: Magnum Opus
abilities.description: Destroys non-boss enemies below 18% health.

name: Amplifier Beacon
description: A humming resonance mast that amplifies the output of every tower around it.
flavor: Turn it up to eleven. Then keep going.

upgrades.name: Harmonic Crescendo
upgrades.description: Periodically drives every nearby tower into a frenzy.

abilities.name: Crescendo
abilities.description: Every 20s, nearby towers deal +50% damage and fire 50% faster for 6s.

name: Spotter Tower
description: A brass crow's nest with a lamp and telescope. Reveals cloaked enemies and marks targets.
flavor: Nothing hides from the lamp.

upgrades.name: Signal Flares
upgrades.description: Enemies in range take a further +10% damage.

upgrades.name: Rangefinder
upgrades.description: Nearby towers gain a further 15% range.

upgrades.name: All-Seeing Eye
upgrades.description: A searchlight that sweeps the whole battlefield.

name: Steam Pressure Booster
description: A manifold of pipes that pumps high-pressure steam into neighbouring machinery.
flavor: More pressure. Always more pressure.

abilities.name: Emergency Valve
abilities.description: Every 15s, nearby towers fire 60% faster for 5s.

upgrades.name: Steam Jacket
upgrades.description: Nearby towers are immune to sabotage and power drain.

name: Gear Forge
description: A small foundry that smelts salvage into gold every wave. Limited to three per level.
flavor: Profit is the best defence.

upgrades.name: Scrap Reclaimer
upgrades.description: Kills near the forge yield +15% gold.

upgrades.name: Salvage Crews
upgrades.description: Kills nearby yield a further +20% gold.

name: Signal Relay
description: A telegraph mast that feeds range-finding data to every tower in reach.
flavor: Dot dot dash. Target acquired.

upgrades.name: Command Nexus
upgrades.description: +15% range, +10% damage and +10% fire rate to nearby towers.

name: Clockwork Snare
description: Fires spring-loaded bolas that tangle legs and gears.
flavor: Tick, tock, stop.

abilities.name: Multi-Snare
abilities.description: Fires at three targets.

upgrades.name: Bear Trap
upgrades.description: 25% chance to stop targets dead for 1s.

abilities.name: Tangle Burst
abilities.description: Every 8s, slows all enemies within 3 tiles by 60% for 3s.

name: Steam Hammer
description: A colossal piston hammer that pounds the ground, crushing and staggering everything nearby.
flavor: When all you have is a hammer, everything is a nail.

upgrades.name: Tectonic Engine
upgrades.description: Every fourth strike splits the earth.

abilities.name: Tectonic Strike
abilities.description: Every 4th strike deals 3x damage and stuns for 1.5s.

name: Sawblade Launcher
description: Flings spinning circular saws that carve through lines of enemies.
flavor: Mind the fingers.

upgrades.name: Ricochet
upgrades.description: Blades bounce to two more enemies.

upgrades.name: Diamond Teeth
upgrades.description: Ignores 6 armour and cuts through two more enemies.

abilities.name: Buzzsaw Storm
abilities.description: Three blades per throw.

upgrades.name: Whirling Death
upgrades.description: A cyclone of blades orbits the tower.

abilities.name: Blade Cyclone
abilities.description: Every 5s, deals 180 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles.

name: Time Distortion Tower
description: A spinning array of escapement wheels that drags nearby time to a crawl.
flavor: Five minutes in there feels like an hour. For them.

upgrades.name: Stasis Pulse
upgrades.description: Periodically freezes everything nearby in time.

abilities.name: Stasis Pulse
abilities.description: Every 10s, freezes enemies within 2.5 tiles for 2s.

upgrades.name: Rewind
upgrades.description: Periodically sends enemies back along their route.

abilities.name: Rewind
abilities.description: Every 9s, rewinds enemies in range 2.5 tiles along their path.

upgrades.name: Chronostasis
upgrades.description: Time itself stops around the tower.

abilities.name: Chronostasis
abilities.description: Every 12s, freezes enemies within 4 tiles for 4s.

name: Gravity Manipulator
description: A levitating lodestone core that bends gravity, crushing and dragging enemies.
flavor: What goes up must come down. On command.

upgrades.name: Grounding Field
upgrades.description: Air units in range are dragged low enough for ground towers to hit.

abilities.name: Event Tether
abilities.description: Every 6s, pulls enemies within 2.5 tiles back 1.5 tiles.

abilities.name: Collapse Point
abilities.description: Every 14s, a 3s singularity pulls in and crushes enemies (250 dps).

name: Singularium Engine
description: Harnesses a caged sliver of collapsed matter. Fires micro-singularities that tear enemies apart. Limited to two per level.
flavor: Handle with extreme prejudice.

upgrades.name: Event Horizon
upgrades.description: +50% blast radius; blasts drag enemies inward.

abilities.name: Hawking Radiation
abilities.description: 4s fields dealing 80 dps.

abilities.name: Singularity Collapse
abilities.description: Every 20s, a 4s singularity crushes enemies within 3.5 tiles (800 dps).

name: Aether Prism
description: A rotating crystal lens that refracts aether into multiple searing beams.
flavor: Light, bent to a purpose.

abilities.name: Refraction
abilities.description: Splits to 1 extra target at 50% damage.

upgrades.name: Cut Facets
upgrades.description: Beams split to three targets at 70% strength.

abilities.name: Facets
abilities.description: Splits to 3 extra targets at 70% damage.

upgrades.name: Focused Lens
upgrades.description: Ramps much faster, to a higher peak.

upgrades.name: Refraction Web
upgrades.description: Beams arc to two nearby enemies.

upgrades.name: Rainbow Cascade
upgrades.description: A dazzling cascade of refracted light.

abilities.name: Rainbow Cascade
abilities.description: Splits to 6 extra targets at 80% damage.

name: Phase Lance
description: Fires a lance that exists slightly out of phase, striking phased, burrowed and cloaked enemies alike.
flavor: It hits you in every reality at once.

upgrades.name: Echo Strike
upgrades.description: Each lance echoes onto a second target.

abilities.name: Echo
abilities.description: Strikes two targets.

abilities.name: Erase
abilities.description: Destroys non-boss enemies below 15% health.
